statement: For M_s=sqrt(1-s)B+sqrt(s)G, with B an n by n iid uniform-sign matrix and G an independent iid standard-normal matrix, F_s(t)=P(s_min(M_s)<=t/sqrt(n)) has no universal monotonic direction in s across all n and t.
source: owner-own-work: ~/brain_workers/w569/ATTEMPT.md; source distribution definitions from Spielman–Teng ICM 2002
proof: At n=1,t=1/2: F_0=0 and F_1=P(|G|<=1/2)>0. At n=2,t=0: F_0=1/2 by four second-row possibilities; for s>0 joint density implies determinant zero has probability 0. The two comparisons have opposite directions.
